rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the majority narrow and institutional, holding §2244(b)(1) inapplicable to §2255 and reading §2244(b)(3)(E) not to bar certiorari over the antecedent mismatch question. The dissent is most likely to be written by Alito (possibly joined by Thomas/Barrett/Kavanaugh) pressing the integrated-cross-reference reading and a categorical jurisdictional bar, with some chance of separate concurrences from Gorsuch or Sotomayor/Jackson to emphasize textualism or fairness concerns.
